ERR_PWRM_NOT_READY.message: The power manager is not ready

ERR_PWRM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.hint: Lower the load, switch off another rail, or use a stronger supply.

ERR_PWRM_BELOW_ALLOCATION.message: The power budget fell to {limit_mW}, below the {allocated_mW} in use
ERR_PWRM_BELOW_ALLOCATION.hint: The supply gives less than before: lower the load or use a stronger supply.

ERR_PWRM_FAULT.hint: Check what is connected to that output (a short, too much load); the board reacted as its power settings say.

ERR_PWRM_BAD_ARG.hint: Use a value within the range shown.

ERR_PWRM_NOT_RAIL.message: {id} is not a power rail of the board
ERR_PWRM_NOT_RAIL.hint: Choose the board or one of its power rails.

ERR_PWRM_NO_OFFER.hint: Connect a USB-C charger that offers power.
